title: [YouPass Collect] - Volunteers across different organizations: 2008 vs 2014
prompt: The charts below show the percentage of volunteers by organizations in 2008 and 2014. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The pie charts compare the proportions of volunteers across six different types of organizations in the years 2008 and 2014.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the data reveal that three categories experienced growth over this period, namely Sport, Environmental and Health Care, while Educational, Art and Others all declined. Notably, Sport volunteering saw the most substantial increase, while Educational volunteering, which was the most popular sector in 2008, experienced the most significant decrease.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the categories that increased, in 2008, Environmental attracted 21% of volunteers, followed by Sport at 15%, while Health Care accounted for just 7%. By 2014, Sport volunteering had surged by 10 percentage points to reach 25%, representing the most dramatic growth among all categories. Similarly, Environmental volunteering rose by 8 percentage points to 29%, becoming the largest sector. Meanwhile, Health Care saw only a modest increase to 8%.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Turning to the declining categories, Educational volunteering was the most prominent in 2008 at 24%, while Art and Others comprised 18% and 15%, respectively. However, Educational volunteering experienced a sharp fall, dropping by 7 percentage points to 17% in 2014. Both Art and Others also decreased by equal margins of 6 percentage points, falling to 12% and 9%, respectively.
